where: country name (list, page title, H1, plan cards)
explanation: The deliberate override keeps the local name as the English does, but the hyphen is invented: the Dutch name (and French usage of it, e.g. «Sint Maarten» beside «Saint-Martin (royaume des Pays-Bas)») has no hyphen; ES and DE in the same table write «Sint Maarten». If changed, the FR_POUR key 'Sint-Maarten' in seo/page-copy.mjs must change with it.
rule: country-name: a form a native reader would use
